# Made once with the last format-10 build (24 Nov 2026, c90d12b, 16 locks a part: format 11 has 32), to keep a project
# as that build saved it for app/tests/locks32.txt: proj_v10.img. Run from the repository's top with the format-10
# build only (kept for the record)
wait 600
# the drums: BD step 1 a chance (75 %), 3 substeps and its own velocity; step 3 on
key 0 down
wait 30
turn K2 -5
wait 30
turn K3 2
wait 30
turn K1 -20
wait 30
key 0 up
wait 30
expect prob0_1 75
expect nlk 3
key 4 down
wait 30
key 4 up
wait 30
expect hit0_3 1
# T3: a note on step 1 with 4 substeps; the snare's DECAY up; the delay's WIDTH 100
turn ALGO 2
wait 30
key 0 down
wait 30
key 0 up
wait 30
key 0 down
wait 30
turn ALGO 5
wait 30
key 0 up
wait 30
expect nsteps3 1
expect inlk3 1
turn ALGO -2
wait 30
key 3 down
wait 20
key 3 up
tap EDIT
wait 100
turn SELECT 1
wait 100
turn K3 5
wait 100
tap FX
wait 30
turn SELECT 3
wait 30
turn K1 100
wait 30
expect fx42 100
tap SAVE
wait 400
expect dirty 0
expect projfmt 10
flash_dump app/tests/fixtures/proj_v10.img
